blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court’s sub judice rule should also be applied to the recent statements of Vice President Sara Duterte, particularly her remarks assailing the integrity of the court. The House prosecution panel made this suggestion on Thursday. House prosecution spokesperson Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong made the pronouncement after confirming that two members of their panel have already received the show–cause orders issued by the impeachment court for alleged violation of the sub judice rule.
